# Missing Error Handling on Cache Retrieval

The get method retrieves a cache entry without any error handling for session execution failures, which could lead to unhandled exceptions if the database is unreachable or if other SQL execution errors occur.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/llm/cache.py` — `knowledge_compiler.llm.cache.LLMCache.get`
